messages:
ana_cs: Heads-up team: Helio tenant goes live tomorrow 09:00 PST. I built a short staged-ramp + telemetry-toggle checklist to avoid surprise renewal flags. Pls review and ack.

mike_sre: Ack. Ops notes: for Dedicated start with batch_size=8 and window_ms=250. For Hosted start with batch_size=4. If p50 latency > 300ms after a ramp step, immediately reduce to batch_size=1 and disable streaming.

simon_te: Tenant runtime flags we'll expose:
```yaml
tenant_toggle:
  enable_streaming: true
  initial_batch_size: 4
  batch_window_ms: 250
  cache_ttl_seconds: 30
  kv_prefix: helios/tenant_id
```
Cache TTL guidance: 30s for conversation flows, 90s for embedding-heavy workloads.

julia_pm: Renewal-risk rule to add to alerts: if month-1 DAU < 15% of expected cohort AND avg error_rate > 1.5% over 6h -> create renewal_risk ticket and CSM outreach within 24h. Before outreach, run this quick checklist: confirm token usage, confirm streaming vs non-streaming behavior, verify model pinned version.

leo_csm: I'll own the kickoff email and the 24h health-check. Draft snippet: "Quick check: are volumes as expected? Any spikes or errors? We have a staged ramp; we can pause if latency increases." Will post to #customer-comms for review. :+1:

mike_sre: On-call runbook quick steps for burst/backpressure: 1) set tenant_toggle.enable_streaming=false 2) set batch_size=1 3) enable fallback_model=smaller-variant 4) escalate if p90 > 1s for >10m. Add this to eng-oncall runbook.

ana_cs: tiny correction -> ana_cs. Also adding a smoke curl check for streaming handshake into the onboarding script. Simon can you drop the curl you mentioned?

simon_te: sure, curl check:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"helios-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .status
```
Expect: {"status":"ok","stream_open":true} else fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy: feature/telemetry-toggle rolled out to staging @ 2026-03-21T09:18:29Z - smoke tests x5 passed.

ana_cs: Thanks all. Action items: leo_csm send kickoff email, simon_te add curl check to onboarding script, mike_sre add on-call snippet, julia_pm add renewal rule to alerts. I'll monitor metrics overnight and flag any tenant-level issues. :eyes:
